purpose: Prevent concurrent AI sessions from integrating against a stale parallel HEAD without serializing independent feature development or preflight.
preconditions: feature/** exact SHA has a successful Parallel feature preflight
feature exact SHA and current parallel HEAD are re-read from live GitHub immediately before integration
all required module-specific workflows for the feature SHA have passed
on_ref_rejected_or_head_changed: re-run parallel feature preflight against the new parallel HEAD
create a fresh merge commit with the new HEAD as first parent
prohibitions: integrating a feature whose preflight evidence belongs to a different feature SHA
reusing a merge commit after parallel HEAD changed
treating an old successful parallel build as evidence for the new HEAD
